name: Next.js + PostgreSQL
description: A full-stack web golden stack: Next.js app router frontend/API routes with a PostgreSQL database behind an ORM.

inputs.name: projectName
inputs.description: npm package name for the generated app.

inputs.name: includeAuth
inputs.description: Scaffold a starter session-based auth module.

inputs.name: orm
inputs.description: ORM used to talk to PostgreSQL.

setup.description: Next.js' own generator creates the project. Unpinned on purpose: the scaffold should be whatever the framework ships today, not whatever it shipped when this pack was written.

setup.command: npm install @prisma/client @prisma/adapter-pg pg && npm install --save-dev prisma @types/pg && npx prisma@latest init --datasource-provider postgresql
setup.description: Installs the ORM chosen by the `orm` input and lets its own CLI lay out prisma/. The app's dependencies are resolved at install time and pinned by the lockfile, which is where pinning belongs.

setup.command: npm install --save-dev @playwright/test @axe-core/playwright && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
setup.description: Playwright plus the accessibility matcher, needed by the end-to-end-tests and accessibility controls at R3.

setup.command: docker compose up -d db && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
setup.description: Brings up PostgreSQL and applies the first migration, so persistence is real before any feature work starts.

requiredArtifacts.description: Next.js app manifest; its lockfile is what pins the dependency set.
Database schema — the single source of truth for the data model.
Production build definition used for the deployment-package control. Authored, not emitted by any CLI, which is why it appears here and not in setup.
Local PostgreSQL and app services, and the target of the clean-environment rehearsal.

verification.description: Unit and integration test suite passes.
Production build succeeds, proving the build control.

operationalEvidence.evidence: Prisma migrations under prisma/migrations/ give a repeatable, versioned persistence lifecycle.
The migrate script is idempotent and every forward migration ships with a documented rollback step.
The Dockerfile builds a pinned, reproducible production image tagged with the build digest.
